thesis: The guest argues that most strategies assume everyone pursues the same outcome, but innovation arises when companies choose different outcomes and fix problems that existing market offerings do not solve. He illustrates this by stating that the major challenge for scientists and creators is not answering a question, but figuring out what question to ask by reframing how the world works.
